items.title: Monohybrid cross, us ki tashreeh aur testcross (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the monohybrid cross and testcross (PDF 84-86).

blocks.text: Apne tajarbon se Mendel ne nateeja nikala ke har mutabadil khasiyaton ke jore mein aik khasiyat F1 hybrids mein zahir nahi hoti, halanke F2 ke 1/4 beejon mein dobara aa jati hai. Is liye jo khasiyat 'ghayab' hui woh F1 beejon mein chhupi hui thi.

blocks.alt: Upar se neeche silsila. Homozygous gol beej (RR) aur homozygous jhurridar beej (rr) se matar ke paude ugte hain; gol beej wale paude ke stamens nikal diye jate hain aur doosre paude se pollen us tak laye jate hain. Gametes banne par maada gamete R aur nar gamete r milte hain aur F1 ke heterozygous gol beej (Rr) bante hain. F1 paude ki self pollination se maada gametes R, r aur nar gametes R, r bante hain jo mil kar F2 beej RR, Rr, Rr aur rr dete hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.1: Mendel ka monohybrid cross (kitab ki Figure 18.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Homozygous round seeds (RR), Homozygous wrinkled seeds (rr), Growth, Stamens removed, Pollens, Gamete formation, Female gametes, Male gametes, Fertilization, F1 seeds, Heterozygous round seeds (Rr), F1 Plants, Self pollination, F2 seeds, 3/4 Round seeds, 1/4 Wrinkled seeds.

blocks.text: Mendel ne samjhaya ke jandaron ki khasiyatein khaas 'factors' qaboo karte hain, jinhein ab genes kehte hain. Har fard diploid hai aur har khasiyat ke do genes rakhta hai; genes chromosomes par hote hain. Jab fard haploid gametes (eggs ya sperms) banata hai to har gamete ko har khasiyat ka aik gene milta hai.

items: Alleles: gene ki mutabadil shaklein jo mutabadil khasiyaton ki taraf le jati hain; gene ki sab copies aik jaisi hona zaroori nahi.
Homozygous: bachche ko aik jaise alleles wala gene jora milta hai, do aise gametes se jin mein aik hi allele ho.
Heterozygous: bachcha aise do gametes se banta hai jin mein alag alleles hon.
Gene: 'DNA ka hissa nucleotides ka silsila jo aik polypeptide banane ka code deta hai'.
Locus: chromosome par gene ki khaas jagah.

blocks.title: Law of segregation (alag hone ka qanoon)
blocks.text: Jab fard gametes banata hai to har gamete ko har gene ki sirf aik copy (allele) milti hai, jo ittefaqan (randomly) chuni jati hai. Jab gametes milte hain to naya fard banta hai jis ka genotype un gametes ke alleles se banta hai.

blocks.title: Maloomat: genotype aur phenotype
blocks.text: Heterozygous fard mein sirf dominant allele zahir hota hai; recessive allele maujood lekin ghair zahir rehta hai. Fard mein alleles ka milap us ka genotype hai; phenotype nazar aane wali khasiyat hai. Genotype naqsha (blueprint) aur phenotype nazar aane wala nateeja hai.

Testcross batata hai ke dominant phenotype homozygous hai ya heterozygous: dominant dikhne wale fard ko recessive se milaya jata hai. Gol beej wala matar RR ya Rr ho sakta hai, jab ke jhurridar hamesha rr hota hai, is liye gol paude ko jhurridar (rr) se milaya jata hai.

items: Agar woh RR hai to sab bachche gol (Rr) honge.
Agar woh Rr hai to bachche gol aur jhurridar 1:1 nisbat (ratio) mein honge.

blocks.title: Rozmarra ki misaal
blocks.text: Aik thaili sochiye jis mein do card hain, aik par R aur aik par r. Har walid aankh band kar ke aik card deta hai. Yahi andha intikhab segregation hai, aur isi liye Rr x Rr se har chaar mein se taqreeban aik bachcha rr hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Gol beej wale matar ka testcross 52 gol aur 49 jhurridar bachche deta hai. Is ka genotype kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Rr. rr ke saath testcross taqreeban 1:1 gol aur jhurridar sirf tab deta hai jab gol walid heterozygous ho; RR walid sirf gol bachche deta.

items: Gol x jhurridar ka F2: 3 gol : 1 jhurridar; genotypes 1 RR : 2 Rr : 1 rr.
Har gamete ko har gene ka aik allele ittefaqan milta hai: law of segregation.
rr ke saath testcross: sab dominant yaani RR; 1:1 yaani Rr.
